paper.title: Rewarding More Is Better for Soliciting Help, Yet More So for Cash Than for Goods: Revisiting and Reframing the Tale of Two Markets With Replications and Extensions of Heyman and Ariely (2004)

review.reason: Accepted as a reading-only scholarly reconstruction with stated source gaps and no runtime or reanalysis claim.
checks: Both studies: N=2203 US MTurk and N=999 UK Prolific; eight conditions; fixed-first Study 2 control; hypothetical outcome scope.
75 PDF quotations verified at cited physical pages. Results preserve unsupported H2, candy-format confound, reversal of control contrast, and Discussion cash-direction discrepancy.
Original QSF pointers checked: affect question randomization, displayed 0–10 options and recodes 1–11. Revised public passages remove runnable-protocol claims.
review.reviewScope: Independent public-Program and primary-paper review, with original linked instrument claims checked against archived source files. No raw-data reproduction or protocol-fidelity attestation.
